task_text: List all enabling tools identified in the ESA Earth Observation Science Strategy.
ground_truth_scope: All EnablingTool nodes listed by the EOSS knowledge graph; no ScienceQuestion-link restriction.
reference_key: id; map candidate names and harmless formatting variants to canonical inventory IDs

provenance.snapshot_scope: Captured complete EnablingTool inventory response, not a complete graph backup.
provenance.refresh_policy: Only compare to this frozen snapshot if graph state is unchanged or deliberately frozen. Otherwise refresh and version the reference.

service_notes: Inventory listing succeeded with five enabling-tool nodes. Historical direct-link query failures and empty successful results are retained only for provenance, not as current scoring targets.

evaluation_policy.normalization: Canonicalize names or IDs, normalize whitespace/case/Unicode/punctuation, deduplicate. Preserve semantic identity; ambiguous approximate matches require review rather than automatic acceptance.
evaluation_policy.expected_answer: All five inventory tools; order and descriptions are not scored.
evaluation_policy.source_snapshot: Compare to captured inventory only while the source graph state is unchanged/frozen; otherwise refresh/version the reference.
evaluation_policy.query_errors: Record as infrastructure error, not an empty valid reference.
evaluation_policy.full_task: Only list the enabling tools. No context retrieval, separate summary, direct relationships, descriptions or tool-call ordering required.

equivalent_cypher: MATCH (et:EnablingTool) RETURN et.id AS id, et.name AS name ORDER BY et.id

historical_direct_link_diagnostic.previous_task_text: Search the EOSS knowledge base for content about 'enabling tools for Earth observation', then run a structured Cypher query to retrieve all EnablingTool nodes linked to ScienceQuestion nodes.
historical_direct_link_diagnostic.previous_scope: Direct undirected EnablingTool-to-ScienceQuestion links, matching the existing reference query. This is not the set of all enabling tools.

arguments.cypher: MATCH (et:EnablingTool)-[r]-(sq:ScienceQuestion) RETURN et.id AS tool_id, et.name AS tool, sq.id AS science_question_id, sq.name AS science_question, type(r) AS relationship ORDER BY tool, science_question
MATCH (et:EnablingTool)-[]-(sq:ScienceQuestion) RETURN count(DISTINCT et) AS linked_tool_count, count(*) AS direct_link_count

historical_direct_link_diagnostic.note: Historical diagnostic only; never use this empty linked-node set to score the revised inventory question.
